 Order

These applications under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. have been filed for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.589/2020 registered at Police Station Shikarpura, District Burhanpur (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 34 of IPC.

The applicants are in custody since 06.05.2025.
2.

As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the present NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:36940 2 MCRC-27697-2025 applicant is that he alongwith co-accused persons by making forged documents committed fraud upon the complainant.
Therefore, case was registered against the present applicant and co-accused persons under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicants are innocent.
They are in custody since 06.05.2025.

It is submitted that earlier the case was registered against the applicants u/S.420 of IPC, but at the time of filing of charge-sheet, Sections 467, 468 and 471 of IPC were added and they have been taken into custody.
It is further submitted that neither they have made any forged document nor they gained any advantage.
There is no criminal record of applicants.

The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicants may be Sheikh Aslam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143864245/
1 released on bail.

sentences.text:
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for it's rejection.
5.
Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicants on bail.

6. Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicants is allowed subject to verification of the fact that the applicants are the first offender.

The applicants are directed to be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
It is directed NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:36940 3 MCRC-27697-2025 that the applicants shall comply with conditions as enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.

7. This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the preconditions of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
8. Accordingly, the application stands allowed.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE Sateesh Sheikh Aslam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143864245/
